_intro.text: Turn on the TV for setup. Each adapter instance controls one TV.

_tvDiscoveryHelp.text: Start this adapter instance, then search for TVs in the local network. You can start the instance before entering a TV address. All discovered addresses are listed; choose one to copy it into TV address. You can also enter an address manually. Save the configuration to use the selected TV.

result.discoveryComplete: Found %s TV addresses. Choose a TV from Discovered TVs and save the configuration.
result.discoveryEmpty: No TVs found. Turn on the TV and check that ioBroker and the TV can communicate in the same local network. You can still enter the TV address manually.
result.discoveryPartial: Found %s TV addresses. The search could not check every network interface or TV. Choose a listed address or enter the TV address manually.
result.discoveryFailed: The TV search failed: %s. You can still enter the TV address manually.

error.discoveryFailed: The TV search failed: %s. You can still enter the TV address manually.
error.discoveryInvalidPort: Enter a whole TV control port from 1 to 65535 before starting the search.
error.discoveryUnavailable: Start this adapter instance before searching for TVs.

_tvDiscoveryNetworkHelp.text: The search runs from the ioBroker host and takes a few seconds. Network isolation or blocked multicast can prevent discovery. A TV that switches off its network in standby cannot be found; turn it on or enable Quick Start. A discovered Loewe device is not a guarantee that this adapter supports its control interface.

host.label: TV address
host.help: Enter the TV's IP address or hostname without http:// or a port. A fixed IP address is recommended.
host.validatorErrorText: Enter the TV's IP address or hostname.

onChange.calculateFunc: typeof data._discoveredTv === 'string' && /^\d{1,3}(?:\.\d{1,3}){3}$/.test(data._discoveredTv) && data._discoveredTv.split('.').every(part => Number(part) <= 255) ? data._discoveredTv : data.host

pollInterval.label: Update interval (seconds)
pollInterval.help: 0 disables automatic status queries, including the initial query at startup. Otherwise, enter 5 to 3600 seconds. Manual commands remain available.
pollInterval.validatorErrorText: Enter 0 or a whole number from 5 to 3600.

maxVolume.label: Maximum volume for direct commands
maxVolume.help: Limits direct volume commands to this TV level. Remote control buttons and changes made on the TV are not limited.

pollPlayback.label: Read current playback
pollPlayback.help: Include current playback in status queries. Disable this if the TV does not support the playback query.

_channelListHelp.text: Turn on the TV and start the adapter to load the available channel lists. Save changes to the TV address or control port first. Then reopen this configuration or use Reload channel lists.

_channelSelectionHelp.text: Only TV stations from this list are created under channels.tv. An empty selection creates no TV station objects. Save the selection to apply it.

channelRefreshInterval.label: Channel refresh interval (seconds)
channelRefreshInterval.help: Refresh the complete selected TV channel list automatically. Default: 300 seconds. 0 disables automatic channel refresh. Manual refresh remains available.
channelRefreshInterval.validatorErrorText: Enter 0 or a whole number from 60 to 86400.

_epgHelp.text: Read the current and next programme directly from the TV and show them under each selected TV channel.

epgRefreshInterval.label: EPG refresh interval (seconds)
epgRefreshInterval.help: Default: 900 seconds. Enter 0 or 300 to 86400 seconds. 0 disables automatic EPG network requests, including at startup. With EPG enabled, channels.epgRefresh still refreshes manually.
epgRefreshInterval.validator: const value = data.epgRefreshInterval === undefined ? 900 : data.epgRefreshInterval; return Number.isInteger(value) && (value === 0 || (value >= 300 && value <= 86400));
epgRefreshInterval.validatorErrorText: Enter 0 or a whole number from 300 to 86400.

_epgGuideHelp.text: The programme guide uses the saved TV and selected channel list. Save changes in the other tabs first. Select a programme to watch it now or confirm a future recording. Open the guide separately using its own link.

_wakeHelp.text: Enable Quick Start and network wake-up on the TV. Without Quick Start, the TV may shut down its network functions in standby and then require the remote control to turn on. Enter the TV's MAC address for the first test and wait at least 30 seconds after switching to standby. The adapter sends Wake-on-LAN, then the TV-on command.

macLan.label: LAN MAC address (optional)
macLan.help: MAC address of the TV's wired network interface, for example AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF.
macLan.validatorErrorText: Enter a MAC address or leave this field empty.

macWlan.label: Wi-Fi MAC address (optional)
macWlan.help: MAC address of the TV's wireless network interface. Waking up over Wi-Fi depends on the TV.
macWlan.validatorErrorText: Enter a MAC address or leave this field empty.

broadcastAddress.label: Broadcast address
broadcastAddress.help: With 255.255.255.255, the adapter also tries a matching local network broadcast when the TV address is IPv4. A different address entered here is used as specified.
broadcastAddress.validatorErrorText: Enter a valid IPv4 broadcast address.

powerOnTimeout.label: Power-on time limit (seconds)
powerOnTimeout.help: Maximum time for waking the network service and sending the dedicated TV-on command. The attempt stops when this limit is reached.
powerOnTimeout.validatorErrorText: Enter a whole number from 5 to 120.

_wakeStatusHelp.text: info.wakeReady shows whether a MAC address is known. info.lastWakeOnLan records packet transmission. info.powerOn shows the current attempt and its result; successful transmission does not confirm a visible picture.

port.label: TV control port
port.help: Leave at 905 unless your TV requires a different port.

timeout.label: Response timeout (milliseconds)
timeout.help: Maximum time to wait for an answer to one TV request.

appendNul.label: Append compatibility byte (NUL)
appendNul.help: Leave enabled to use the request format of Loewe App 1.4.7.
